the arXiv API, and the title/date printed here is arXiv's, not a search snippet. PDFs are
checked into `docs/papers/pdf/` (84 files,
named `{Paper Title}.pdf` -- see `docs/papers/PAPERS.md` for the naming convention and the
per-paper Applied/Failed/Reference status this file doesn't track.

## Not on arXiv (fetch by hand)

- Aho & Corasick (1975), *Efficient string matching: an aid to bibliographic search*, CACM 18(6) — the matcher in `entities/automaton.py`.
- Haveliwala (2002), *Topic-sensitive PageRank*, WWW — personalized PageRank, `graph/ppr.py`.
- WikiMAG (AAAI) — multi-agent Wikipedia-like generation; the closed-vocabulary `page_outline` is a static version of its planner.
